name: io.github.rtahabas/gatewards
description: Drop-in spend governance + cross-agent dedup proxy for AI agent fleets, with x402 settlement.
title: Gatewards

environmentVariables.name: GATEWARDS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Gatewards agent API key (gw_agent_…). Required for authenticated proxy calls; the server starts without it but cannot reach the gateway.

environmentVariables.name: GATEWARDS_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to http://localhost:3001; set to https://api.gatewards.com for the hosted gateway.
